nodes.text:
As per the ICMR, two infants were tested positive for the HMPV virus in Bengaluru earlier today. 

A third case has been reported from Gujarat’s Ahmedabad, where a 2-month old child was diagnosed with the virus.

With this, the official tally for India has now gone up to 3 cases. https://t.co/BY7dG0CGi8
